svg.title: Control Studio's Smith predictor on the heater with a 1 s delivery delay
svg.desc: Control Studio identified the heater as 0.2 degrees per percent with a 4.9 second time constant and a 1.1 second delay and designed a Smith predictor. In its validation run the water reaches 63 percent of a 0.5 degree step at 2.8 seconds with 0.1 percent overshoot. With the model delay set to 0.6 seconds the overshoot is 0.6 percent; with the same gains and model gain 0 it is 15.1 percent.
